overview_description.description:
Nilus is a plug-and-play platform that automates reconciliation, reporting, and payment workflows to empower finance teams with financial transparency and complete control.

By unifying data from your payment providers, banks, platform, and ERP, Nilus creates a single source of financial truth for all your payment activity.

Nilus provides a seamless plug-and-play experience for financial operators. With our automated workflows, pre-built data connectors, and smart reconciliation algorithms, Nilus eliminates dependence on tech teams and spreadsheets to get the job done.

about_short_description.short_description: Nilus is a cash management platform that automates reconciliation and payment workflows.

product.name: Cash Positions
product.description: A dashboard to manage and view real-time cash balances, exposures, and policies across banks, currencies, and entities.

product.name: Cash Flow Forecasting
product.description: A tool that uses AI to generate accurate cash flow forecasts based on historical and expected transactions.

product.name: Accounting Automation
product.description: Automates accounting workflows such as bank and gateway reconciliation, collections management, and journal entry creation.

product.name: Integrations
product.description: Connects and syncs cash data from over 20,000 banks, payment gateways, ERPs, and other financial systems without IT involvement.

product.name: Nilus AI
product.description: An AI engine that tags transactions, provides liquidity insights, answers complex queries, and suggests treasury actions.

product.name: Automated Receivables
product.description: Automates matching of incoming payments to invoices using AI to reduce days sales outstanding and errors.
